title: Do Plants Talk?
topic: วิทยาศาสตร์
lines: Plants cannot move or make sounds, but scientists have discovered that
**they** can still send messages. When a caterpillar starts eating the
leaves of a tomato plant, the plant releases special chemicals into the
air. Nearby tomato plants detect **these** chemicals and begin producing
substances that make their leaves taste bitter. As a result, insects are
Plants also communicate underground. Their roots are connected by a huge
network of fungi, sometimes called the "wood wide web." Through **it**,
older trees can send water and sugar to young trees growing in the shade.
One researcher found that a single old tree was linked to more than forty
others in its forest. Cutting down **such** trees, she warns, can harm the
whole forest. Not everyone agrees that plants "talk" in the way animals do,
but **most** scientists accept that they share information in surprising
